Metadata.title: Activos Kairos — We build the systems that grow your business
Metadata.description: We design, automate and run your company's internal systems. From operational chaos to an operation that runs itself: consulting and custom digital assets.

Problem.titleA: You work harder than ever, and still,
Problem.v1q: That figure… where was it again?
Problem.v2q: Only Irene knows how that works.
Problem.v2dx: Knowledge lives inside one person's head
Problem.v4q: We keep it in five different places.

Problem.closingB: It's a lack of a system.

Methodology.title: Four steps. An asset that is yours.
Methodology.lead: No black boxes: every decision is documented inside your own Notion.
Methodology.s1d: We map how you work today and where the time leaks away. No filler meetings.
Methodology.s2d: We define the structure of your ERP, CRM or management system on Notion.
Methodology.s3d: We connect your tools and add AI where it genuinely saves work.
Methodology.s4d: We train your team and fine-tune the system until it runs on its own.

Services.title: Five assets that support your company from start to finish.
Services.lead: You start by setting up your workspace, build the assets you need and keep them alive. You choose where you are.
Services.initiaBody: We set up your base workspace —databases, teamspaces, views and permissions— and train your team to use it from day one. No starting from a blank page.
Services.initiaResult: A working space and a team that knows how to use it.
Services.fluxBody: We connect your tools and automate the flows you run by hand today: sign-ups, follow-ups, reports and alerts. Information travels between systems on its own, with no copy-pasting.
Services.fluxResult: An operation that saves time and sustains itself.
Services.sophosBody: We design and build the assets your operation needs —tailor-made, documented and with training included— so knowledge stops living inside people's heads.
Services.sophosResult: Processes that don't depend on a single person.
Services.tempoBody: Monthly membership: every month we add new assets, improve your systems and train your team on what's new. Weekly reports and incident handling included.
Services.tempoResult: An operation that keeps improving, month after month.
Services.stasisBody: We resolve errors and incidents with no limits and keep your systems up to date, with a team always trained on the latest technology. No lock-in.
Services.stasisResult: Continuous stability and a response within 24 working hours.
Services.bannerBody: We look at how your company works today, spot where you're losing time and tell you honestly whether we can help and where to begin. No strings attached.

Cases.title: Results you feel day to day.
Cases.leadAccent: 5 operations turned into assets that run themselves
Cases.mintechSummary: From manual processes and disconnected systems → to a centralised, automated multi-currency operation.
Cases.mintechReto: Day-to-day management relied on multiple manual processes and disconnected systems, making it hard to access up-to-date information in real time. With no consolidated view per currency, the team had to repeat validation and follow-up tasks, cutting into the time available for higher-value strategic work.
Cases.mintechSolucion: We implemented a centralised platform with real-time synchronisation, able to manage multi-currency operations from a single environment. Automating conversions, alerts and workflows removed unnecessary manual work and enabled direct integration with the client portal, guaranteeing consistent information and more efficient contract management.
Cases.mintechR1: More than 10 hours a week recovered by eliminating duplicate data entry between systems.
Cases.mintechR2: Contract handling time cut from several hours to just a few minutes through automated processes.
Cases.mintechR3: Real-time database synchronisation, improving traceability and the reliability of information.
Cases.mintechR4: More than 30 contracts a week managed with multi-currency operations and automated alerts.
Cases.lasaviaSummary: From managing members by hand → to a centralised system that syncs and scales on its own.
Cases.lasaviaReto: The steady growth of the investor community created an ever-heavier operational load. Managing members, documentation and transactions by hand made information hard to trace, limited visibility over the state of investments and increased the risk of errors in the process.
Cases.lasaviaSolucion: We implemented a centralised system for the end-to-end management of members and investments. Each investor has private access to their own information, while transactions are synchronised and updated automatically through automation flows, guaranteeing operational efficiency, scalability and continuous control.
Cases.lasaviaR1: 3 hours a week freed up by automating member reporting.
Cases.lasaviaR2: New member onboarding cut from 4 hours to a few minutes.
Cases.lasaviaR3: More than 50 transactions managed with real-time tracking and updates.
Cases.lasaviaR4: Automatic data synchronisation and the removal of repetitive manual tasks.
Cases.finanzasSummary: From non-standardised processes → to a documented, automated operation ready to grow.
Cases.finanzasM1L: per client, from payment to delivery
Cases.finanzasReto: The company's rapid expansion made it clear that processes needed structure, information needed centralising and the dependence on manual tasks had to come down. The lack of operational standardisation made scaling difficult and limited the team's capacity to grow.
Cases.finanzasSolucion: We designed a centralised management and documentation system in Notion, integrating commercial, operational and administrative processes. We automated lead capture, sales follow-up, marketing actions and sales management, letting the team spend more time on high-value work and strategic growth.
Cases.finanzasR1: 30 minutes saved per client in the process from payment to delivery of the first service, thanks to automated flows.
Cases.finanzasR2: A 15% drop in costs associated with acquisition and invoicing.
Cases.finanzasR3: Team operational capacity up by more than 350% after rollout.
Cases.finanzasR4: Platform running for more than 18 months, supporting the company's continuous growth.
Cases.biventiaSummary: From scattered tools → to a unified digital ecosystem with AI and a client portal.
Cases.biventiaReto: Alternative investment operations relied on multiple tools and information sources disconnected from one another. That fragmentation made the advisor network harder to manage, reduced visibility over data and created a heavy administrative load just to keep information current and aligned.
Cases.biventiaSolucion: We designed a unified digital ecosystem that centralises the management of clients, advisors and investments. The platform integrates automatic data synchronisation, a client portal, digital signature processes and artificial intelligence tools to speed up query resolution. We also connected lead capture to the CRM, guaranteeing continuous, traceable commercial management.
Cases.biventiaR1: Full automation of onboarding and document signing.
Cases.biventiaR2: Time spent on operational tasks cut from 3 hours to 30 minutes per partner.
Cases.biventiaR3: AI agents deployed that reduce information scatter by 80%.
Cases.biventiaR4: More than 600% growth in expansion and commercial development capacity since the start of the engagement.
Cases.martilloSummary: From scattered financial control → to a single platform with traceability and automatic alerts.
Cases.martilloReto: The group's financial and document management depended on scattered processes and knowledge that was never centralised. Expenses, payments, licences and policies had no unified control system, creating operational risk, poor visibility and a heavy dependence on key people.
Cases.martilloSolucion: We designed and rolled out a centralised platform in Notion to manage the financial and legal operations of every company in the group. The system integrates expense control, purchase orders, payments, legal documentation and automatic expiry alerts, guaranteeing traceability, control and access segmented by company.
Cases.martilloR1: 20 hours a week freed up by automating administrative tasks and cash closings.
Cases.martilloR2: More than 500 cash movements a month managed from a single platform.
Cases.martilloR3: A 50% reduction in purchase order processing time.
Cases.martilloR4: Licence and policy review time cut from 3 hours to 15 minutes a week.
Cases.martilloQuote: The way the Kairos team works is incredible.
